summary: fix(webui): resolve LD password verification crash and config indicator gap
decisions: PENDING token now always stores user.id (LinuxDo provider int) instead of local_user.id (UUID) to match get_user_by_provider lookup
Config page password field uses hasValuePath schema extension to show placeholder when bcrypt hash exists

bugs.symptom: LD password verification returned 500 Internal server error JSON
bugs.root_cause: issue_pending_token stored local_user.id (UUID) for existing users; verify handler called int(pending["uid"]) on UUID string causing ValueError
bugs.fix: Always pass str(user.id) to issue_pending_token — consistent with verify handler which looks up by provider_user_id

bugs.symptom: Config page LD password field always appeared empty even when password was set
bugs.root_cause: Config stores access_password_hash (bcrypt), frontend maps to access_password (plaintext) which is never returned
bugs.fix: Add hasValuePath to field schema; renderInput shows "已设置" placeholder when hash exists
